title: Blue Prism Online Training
description:
About BLUE PRISM Online Training:

Blue Prism Online Training is an RPA Tool which holds the potential of virtual workforce powered by software robots. This helps the enterprises to automate the business operations in an agile and cost-effective manner.
Blue Prism may be a UK-based software development company within the field of Robotic Process Automation. The group supplies software robot which helps to automate clerical back office processes that employment exactly sort of a human.
The Robotic Process Automation which is shortly referred to as (RPA) was invented by Blue Prism. This fact itself shows that the corporate is pioneers in RPA software development.
Blue Prism Online Training software enables business operations to be agile and price effective by automating, manual, rule-based, repetitive back-office processes and improving accuracy by developing a “Digital Workforce.”. The Blue prism tool offers flow chart like designer with drag and drop feature to automate each step of the business processes.
In this tutorial, you will learn
• What is Blue Prism?
• Blue prism Features
• Components of Blue Prism
• What is Object Studio?
• What is Process studio?
• What is Business Objects
• Benefits of using Blueprism
• Blue-prism International Case Studies

Prerequisites:

• Enough knowledge of Network certification
• Enough knowledge of Windows Server Administrative tasks
• Anyone with basic programming knowledge like C Language and Java can also do the Blue Prism Training Course
